hook.name: ERC20THook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for ERC20T tokens that collects configurable per-token swap taxes, converts buy-side fees to ETH via nested swaps, and distributes proceeds to per-token fee recipients and a shared protocol fee recipient (fixed 0.15%). Only exact-input swaps are permitted; pool launches and external liquidity access are owner-controlled.
